responsibility: Implements the general MIR peephole-combining pass that performs small local simplifications on statements and terminators after earlier canonicalization passes. It rewrites boolean comparisons and redundant ref/deref patterns, folds array-length and identity or transmute-like casts into simpler MIR forms, turns trivial `Clone` calls on copy-like primitives into direct copies, simplifies validity-check intrinsics based on known layout facts, and also merges duplicate `SwitchInt` targets to clean up control flow.
